disc-3.definition:
import { createGroupTransformRecipe } from "../../shared/group-transform";

export const disc3Recipe = createGroupTransformRecipe({ rotate: 90 }, { duration: 0.4, ease: "easeInOut" });
disc-3.adapter:
---
import Icon, { type IconProps } from "../../Icon.astro";

type Props = IconProps;
---

<Icon {...Astro.props} tag="grave-disc-3">
  <g>
    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2" />
    <g data-motion="0" style="transform-origin: 12px 12px">
      <path d="M6 12c0-1.7.7-3.2 1.8-4.2" />
      <path d="M18 12c0 1.7-.7 3.2-1.8 4.2" />
    </g>
  </g>
</Icon>

<script>
  import "./element";
</script>
